name: TESSERACT
full_name: Transition Edge Sensors with Sub-Ev Resolution And Cryogenic Targets
summary: TESSERACT is a multitarget, ultralow-threshold dark-matter programme combining HeRALD superfluid helium, SPICE polar/scintillating crystals and French cryogenic Ge/Si technology. This record covers the overall programme, with its subprojects listed as phases.
detection_principle: TES sensors measure tiny energies from phonons, photons or quantum-evaporated helium atoms. Different targets and signal combinations probe different masses and couplings and help investigate nonparticle low-energy backgrounds.

science_scope: This record covers experiments that directly measure possible interactions between dark matter and ordinary matter. Published exclusion limits, background events and projected sensitivities do not constitute a dark-matter discovery.
